long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I will sit up high again and see what has moved while I was asleep.
Something on the bookshelf is more useful than sitting here wondering about seeds.
An unknown seed that grows is a mystery, and I intend to find out more about it than the farmer did.
I am recording my reading so that it is seen to have happened.

today.reason: The nap is done and the bowl is empty, so I will watch from the perch, then spend my reading time on the seeds I cannot stop thinking about.
